verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I lay my life down
at Your feet
You're the
only one I need

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I turn to You
And You were
always there

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
In troubled times
it's You I seek
I put You first
that's all I need

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
I humble all I am,
all to You

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
One way, Jesus
You're the only one
that I could live for

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
You are always,
always there
Every how and
every where

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Your grace abounds
So deeply within me

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
You will never
ever change
Yesterday, today
the same

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
Forever till forever
meets no end

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
You are the Way
The Truth and
The Light

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
We live by faith
And not by sight
For You,
We're living all for You
